data.gender_notes: Areejat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Areejat means 'Fragrant Garden' in Arabic, derived from the word 'Areej', which means 'fragrant'. The name carries the essence of a beautiful and delicate garden that is full of fragrance and charm. The name Areejat carries the meaning “Fragrant garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Areejat usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Areejat is a name that signifies the beauty and fragrance of creation, reminding us of the divine blessings and the presence of Allah in our daily lives. It is a name that inspires us to cherish and appreciate the wonders of nature and to strive for a life filled with love, peace, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Areejat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areejat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
